$comment: legacy_invoices.* — the scoped legacy-invoices module's own strings. The FILENAME is the namespace: the loader parses modules/NAME-en.json as NAME, so every key here resolves as legacy_invoices.KEY. The sibling invoices-en.json is a DIFFERENT namespace (invoices.*, the live invoices module) — do not merge the two. These are the archive list's column headers and the single-read detail labels, consumed by the labs scenario presentation (legacy-invoices.presentation.ts).
